_metadata.description: Validate the target scenario's package.json against the component's declared @deps before adoption.

requirements.title: Component dep declarations are parsed from the @deps header field
requirements.description: Indexer parses the optional `@deps` field as JSON `[{"name": "react", "range": "^18.0.0"}, ...]`. Missing field → empty array. Malformed JSON → indexer error per CR-002. Parsed rows go into `component_dep_declarations` (soft FK to components.id).

validation.notes: Indexer test feeds headers with valid, missing, and malformed @deps; repository test asserts dep rows.

requirements.title: On adopt, validator compares declared deps against target scenario's package.json
requirements.description: `POST /api/v1/adoptions/preview {component_id, target_scenario}` reads the target's `package.json` (via storage resolver scoped to the scenarios root), runs semver intersection against each declared dep, and returns a verdict: `ok | warn | block`. `block` fires when a major-version range cannot be satisfied; `warn` fires when a dep is missing or minor/patch ranges don't intersect.

validation.notes: Service test covers each verdict with synthetic package.jsons; BAS flow `dep-mismatch-blocks-adopt` exercises the block path end-to-end.

requirements.title: Adoption UI surfaces dep verdicts and blocks proceed on block
requirements.description: Adoption modal shows the dep verdict before confirm. `ok` enables proceed; `warn` enables proceed with an acknowledgment checkbox; `block` disables proceed and shows the failing dep + reason.

validation.notes: Component test renders the modal against each verdict fixture and asserts proceed-button state.
